source.column: Deficit(+)/surplus(-) EXCLUDING correspondent accounts, third column; billion RUB at start of observation day. Not the reserve-adjusted revised headline.
source.availability: Conditional end of the following calendar day Moscow; original publication/vintages not proved. Existing RUONIA publication-plus-one-day clock can delay joint availability further. No assumption that the flow-table10:30 announcement applies to this stock table.
source.rights: CBR attributed private noncommercial research, raw/notices retained outside Git. No commercial data product, raw redistribution or live rights inferred from this screen.

monetary.selection: One joint event for every admitted RUONIA observation date; exact same observation date for key rate and beginning-of-day bank deficit. No comparison of old RUONIA with a newer policy rate. Official USD/RUB and other RUONIA columns are not interpreted.
monetary.clock: RUONIA: midnight Moscow after printed publication date; key rate: midnight after effective date, unchanged from existing admitted sources. Joint available_at is max of all three clocks. Availability>=2026 Moscow excluded BEFORE numeric cells. 52 additional key-only dates are not fabricated RUONIA trades.

signal.mechanism: Expensive ruble funding when banks are net borrowers from CBR may induce sale of FX/reduction of short-RUB funding positions, predicting subsequent RUB appreciation. Joint financing quantity and realized funding-price premium, not a generic healthy-economy indicator or a key-rate level governor. Transmission may already be priced or be overwhelmed by sanctions/capital controls.
signal.primary: SI short0.9 iff same-date RUONIA-key_rate>0 AND unadjusted bank deficit>0; otherwise cash. Exact Decimal comparisons, zero means cash.
signal.control: SI short0.9 iff RUONIA-key_rate>0, irrespective of deficit sign, but with identical three-input readiness. Diagnostic only, not independently promotable.
signal.missing: Latest joint event with absent/null selected cell masks both arms, no older-good fallback, zero fill or interpolation. Source gap can only retain last known state until TTL7; all decision days kept. No artificial RUONIA observation for holidays/key-only dates.
